name: haze
description: Haze: a fragrance & candle shop PWA built around discovery. Swipe scent quiz, interactive SVG scent wheel, side-by-side compare, build-your-own sample box. React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Zustand, Motion, Playwright.

paragraphs: Fragrance, found slowly. Haze is a shop for a small (made-up) Lagos fragrance and candle house, built around the hard part of buying perfume online: you can’t smell it. So instead of a grid and a buy button, it gives you ways in. Swipe through smells you already know and get matched with reasons. Spin a scent wheel to see what a note smells like and which perfumes carry it. Put three bottles side by side. Then try five as 2 ml vials, and get what you paid back as credit on a full bottle.

It’s a front-end project. The catalogue, pricing and payment gateway are mocks inside this repo, so it clones and runs with no keys and no backend. Haze, its perfumers and its prices are fictional; the photographs are real.
features: Scent quiz. Eight cards, from sea spray at dawn to the end of a fire. Drag a card right to keep it, left to pass (or use the buttons, or ← →). Three dials follow: fresh or cosy, how loud, day or night. The result is a…

Scent wheel. An SVG wheel of eight families and thirty-two notes. Tap a family or note, or drag to spin it; on release it settles on the family at the top. The side panel says what the note smells like and lists every…

Product pages show the family mix as a coloured “blotter strip”, a tappable note pyramid, and a dry-down slider: drag through the day and watch the top notes fade, the heart peak and the base take over. Engrave the cap…

Compare up to three perfumes in a table that highlights the notes they share, with strength, longevity, best time and price per ml. Add from any card; a floating tray follows you until you open it. The URL is shareable.

Sample box. Pick five 2 ml vials (they fill with the colour of each perfume’s main family), reorder them, or let it fill the rest. The ₦18,000 comes back as credit on your next full-size bottle for thirty days, worked…
